outcome: Macronutrient content of donor human milk (fat, dry matter, energy, total protein, true protein)
cohort: The study included 365 healthy donor mothers and their infants from Southern China.
finding: Maternal obesity status, early stage of lactation, and infant gender were associated with significant differences in the macronutrient content of donor human milk.
mod_finding: There was no statistical significance found between mode of delivery and DHM macronutrient content.
birth_weight: Infant birth weight was recorded and analyzed, but specific inclusion criteria or ranges for birth weight are not mentioned.
